Eligibility of Tenderer : This invitation for tender is open to all eligible/ Bona fide Tenderers:
a) Up to date valid Trade license
b) Valid TIN & VAT registration Certificate
c) Up to date valid Income Tax clearance certificate
d) The minimum number of years of general experience of the Tenderer in the construction works as Prime Contractor or
Subcontractor or Management Contractor shall be 05 (Five) years.
e) The minimum specific experience as a Prime Contractor or Subcontractor or Management Contractor in construction works
under public sector of at least 01 contract of similar nature of work successfully completed within the last 05 years, with a value of
at least Tk. 680.00 Lac
f) The required average annual construction turnover under public sector shall be greater than 09.00 Lac over the last 05 financial
years and Minimum Tender Capacity shall be 07.00 Lac.
g) The minimum amount of financial resources as liquid asset or working capital or credit line(s) or specific credit commitment in
the form of Letter of Credit Commitment for Bank’s undertaking for Line of Credit (Form e-PW2A-8) Only without alteration or in
any combination of them, of the Tenderers shall be Tk 09.00 Lac.
h) Up to date valid A/B/C category Contractor & Electrical Supervisory license (FY 2025-26)
i) Met all other required qualifications, special terms & conditions of the tender as mentioned in the ITT, GCC & Tender data sheet
(TDS) & Tender documents.
